subject: general
question: Which of the following was the first Regional Rural Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prathma Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Prathma Bank** was the first Regional Rural Bank (RRB) established in India.
 
• It was set up on **2nd October 1975**, under the provisions of the RRB Act, 1976.
 
• Prathma Bank was sponsored by **Syndicate Bank**, one of the leading public sector banks.
 
• The bank operates primarily in the rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, with a focus on providing credit and financial services to the agrarian and rural sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)**

 
 
• RRBs were established to provide sufficient banking and credit facilities for agriculture and other rural sectors.
 
• They were created with a view to include rural areas into the economic mainstream by providing financial services.
 
• The RRB Act, 1976, which governs RRBs, aims to develop the rural economy by providing financial aid to small farmers, artisans, and agricultural laborers.
 
 
 
• **Syndicate Bank**
 
 
• Syndicate Bank was a major public sector bank in India before its merger with Canara Bank in 2020.
 
• It played a significant role in the establishment of the first RRB, Prathma Bank.
 
 
 
• **RRB Act, 1976**
 
 
• This act provides the legal framework for the establishment and functioning of RRBs in India.
 
• It mandates that RRBs should be jointly owned by the Central Government, the State Government, and the sponsoring public sector bank.
 
 
 
• **Current Status of RRBs**
 
 
• As of now, there are several RRBs operating across various states, contributing significantly to rural development and financial inclusion.
 
• These banks have been instrumental in the implementation of various government schemes aimed at rural and agricultural development.
